title: RNA extraction from field-collected brain tissue samples from suspect rabid animals
author: Kirstyn Brunker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdcei2te

steps.title: Prepare Homogenizer Tube
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 mL reinforced tube for homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.4mm ceramic beads to the tube (use a 0.2ml PCR tube to measure the approximate amount of beads).
Add ~1 mL of RNA/DNA shield using a pipette or disposable plastic pastette.

steps.title: Process Tissue Samples (RNA Later/Glycerol-Saline)
steps.instruction: Prepare and homogenize tissue samples stored in RNA later or glycerol-saline.

substeps.instruction: Remove a small piece of tissue (50-100mg) using a wooden applicator stick, toothpick, or forceps and dab excess liquid on filter paper.
If the sample has liquefied: Transfer 200 µL of liquid to a new 2ml screw cap tube, add 200 µL of RNase-free water or PBS (1:1), then add 4 volumes of RNA Lysis Buffer (4:1) and mix.
Add the tissue (or liquefied mixture) to the prepared homogenizer tube and screw the lid on securely.
Insert the tube into the Terralyzer lysis chamber and replace the chamber shield.
Homogenize for approximately 00:02:00, followed by 00:00:30 pulses if required until fully homogenized.
Leave for 00:02:00 to allow sample inactivation.
Transfer 350 µL of the homogenised sample to a new 2ml screw cap tube.
Add 350 µL of RNA Lysis Buffer (1:1) and mix well.

steps.title: Process Homogenized Samples (DNA/RNA Shield)
steps.instruction: Prepare samples already homogenized and stored in DNA/RNA shield.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 350 µL of homogenised sample to a new 2 mL screw cap tube using a pipette or disposable plastic pastette.
Add 350 µL of RNA Lysis Buffer (1:1) and mix well.

steps.title: Remove Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Use the Zymo Research Quick-RNA miniprep kit to remove genomic DNA. Perform all centrifugation steps at 10,000 x g to 16,000 x g for 00:00:30 unless otherwise specified.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the 700 µL sample lysed in RNA Lysis Buffer into a yellow Spin-Away Filter column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge and save the flow-through (reload columns if processing samples >700 μl).

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the Zymo-Spin IIICG column.

substeps.instruction: Add a 1:1 volume of ethanol (95-100%) to the saved flow-through and mix well by pipetting up and down.
Transfer the mixture to a green Zymo-Spin IIICG column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Perform On-Column DNase I Treatment
steps.instruction: Digest contaminating DNA on the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized DNase I according to the vial instructions.
Add 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge, and discard the flow-through.
In an RNase-free tube, mix 5 µL DNase I with 75 µL DNA Digestion Buffer.
Add the DNase mix directly to the column matrix, avoiding contact between the pipette tip and the filter matrix.
Incubate the column at room temperature for 00:15:00.

steps.title: Wash RNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column to remove reagents and contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL RNA Prep Buffer to the column, centrifuge, and discard the flow-through.
Add 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge, and discard the flow-through.
Add 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer and centrifuge for 00:02:00 to ensure complete removal of the wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute Purified RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the column into a 1.5 mL eppendorf tube.
Add 50 µL DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix and centrifuge.
Collect the flow-through (purified RNA).
Use the eluted RNA immediately or store at ≤ -70 °C.
